mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies and a temperature of 72 degrees, which feels more like 77 near Reddan Soccer Park. We are also under a waxing crescent moon phase today.

If you are looking to get involved in the community, the Verona Senior Center is currently accepting volunteer applications. They need help with various programs and ask that volunteers commit to at least two visits per month. Please note that some roles require physical activity, and all volunteers must sign a confidentiality agreement.

There is plenty to do around town. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmers Market or catch live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Cave Carnival at Cave of the Mounds or the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena.

In our weekly police report, we noted that on Wednesday, an officer observed a vehicle driving erratically and arrested the 49-year-old driver for an O W I, fourth offence, which resulted in a blood draw and jail booking.
You are in for a treat because the flavor of the day at Culver's is Turtle. They are open until 10:30 PM, so there is plenty of time to stop by for a delicious frozen dessert.
